releaseTitle: ATalk v3.16.0 — Complete Security & Anti-Attack Hardening Release
releaseNotes:
• 01 Cryptographic PIN & Vault Security (PBKDF2): Upgraded the Secret Vault PIN hashing from plain SHA-256 to PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA256, 10,000 iterations, and a cryptographically secure 16-byte per-user salt. Fully eliminates rainbow-table, dictionary, and GPU-accelerated hash inversion.
• 02 Vault Anti-Brute-Force & Lockout System: Built active exponential backoff and lockout protection into the PIN unlock dialog (30s after 5 failed attempts, 2m after 8, 5m after 10). Failed attempt counters and timestamps are cryptographically enforced across app reboots.
• 03 Supabase Cloud Database & RLS Isolation: Migrated sensitive user recovery credentials out of the public profiles directory into an isolated private table (`public.user_security_credentials`) with strict RLS (`auth.uid() = user_id`). Completely prevents credential harvesting and profile scraping.
• 04 Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA) Elimination: Hardened all direct database procedures (`send_message_direct`, `get_conversation_messages`, `delete_message_direct`, `set_user_password`) to strictly enforce caller identity verification (`auth.uid()`) and room membership checks. Unauthorized users can no longer read or inject messages into arbitrary conversations.
• 05 Storage Bucket Hardening: Sealed `chat-attachments` storage bucket against unauthenticated anonymous uploads and tampering; updates and deletions are restricted to verified object owners (`owner = auth.uid()`).
• 06 Network Security Config & Trust Anchor Protection: Implemented Android Network Security Configuration prohibiting all cleartext HTTP traffic across the application and restricting trust anchors strictly to system certificate authorities, thwarting Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
• 07 OTA Update Package Integrity (SHA-256): Hardened the in-app update installer to download APKs strictly to private internal app cache and verify cryptographic SHA-256 checksums before initiating package installation, eliminating malicious APK spoofing and MITM injection.
• 08 Search Path Hijacking Prevention: Pinned `search_path = public, auth, pg_temp` across all SECURITY DEFINER functions, resolving 100% of Supabase database advisor security warnings.
